title: DG4 - Collapse
claim: If a required lower layer collapses, any higher layer depending on it collapses unless an explicit repair or alternate dependency is supplied.
assumptions: Dependency creates vulnerability unless repaired or rerouted.
definitions: Collapse: loss of required dependency structure.
negative_guards: Do not let dependent claims keep higher status than their failed dependencies.
kill_conditions: A dependent layer remains valid after its required lower layer collapses with no repair or alternate dependency.
Collapse propagation cannot be distinguished from ordinary revision.

ledger.meaning: Source claim ingested into Lane 4 ledger.
